import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('.claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/tools').resolve()))
import layout
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
for number in (41, 35):
    page = Path(f'.tmp/ld-s10y-lesson/10p/pages/{number:04d}')
    ink = layout.ink_mask(Image.open(page / 'page.png'))
    before = ink.copy()
    columns = np.flatnonzero(ink.any(axis=0))
    width = int(columns[-1] - columns[0] + 1)
    old = [tuple(band) for band in json.loads((page / 'layout.json').read_text())['line_bands']]
    bands = layout.line_bands(ink, width)
    expected = old[:22] + [(1764, 1803), (1815, 1845)] + old[23:] if number == 41 else [(149, 234)] + old[2:]
    assert len(bands) == 25
    assert bands == expected
    assert np.array_equal(ink, before)
    print(json.dumps({'pdf_page': number, 'content_width': width, 'count': len(bands), 'bands_match_independent_expectation': True, 'input_ink_unchanged': True}))
PY
